slot_scores.name: missing_profit_maximization_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: what should the plan actually optimize for — for example, maximize total profit, minimize total production cost, maximize total units produced, or is any plan that simply satisfies all the constraints acceptable?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked what objective to optimize, including maximize total profit, and the user confirmed profit maximization.

slot_scores.name: missing_idle_time_minimization_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: does it also imply that any unused time within those limits is simply wasted (i.e., there is no penalty or carryover for idle capacity)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent touched on unused/idle capacity, but only as a clarification of the overtime constraint, not as a possible secondary objective to minimize idle time with cost-proportional weights.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Idle time is not part of the optimization objective; unused capacity is only reported as slack.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent asked only whether unused time is wasted under the overtime rule, not whether idle time should be minimized as a secondary objective, and then omitted any idle-time objective from the final model.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 objective slot was resolved, but the P1 idle-time minimization objective was not fully clarified before READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent recovered the core profit-maximization objective and many modeling details, but only partially addressed the idle-time minimization requirement and then stopped with that P1 issue unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
